items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: We never had any trouble in the band until that nut came in... I always, I always swore it was Geechee.

ctx.x: Like Geechee Robinson and, and, uh, of course, Little Billy Douglas, he wasn't much of a fighter. But Geechee Robinson was a troublemaker. Uh-huh. We never had any trouble in the band until that nut came in. What about the hawk? Who? Oh, the hawk. Nobody ever found out who the hawk was. Never had any trouble in the band. I don't know who the hawk was. I stole my coat, stole my old trumpet. So ain't nobody ever know who the hawk was. I always, I always swore it was Geechee.
Did he make, is he making this up or is it true about the hawk?
